after.description:
Giftly remembers the people you love — their birthdays, anniversaries and the dates that matter — and helps you always show up with the right gift.

REMEMBER EVERYONE
Add the people you care about with their birthday and the days you celebrate together: wedding anniversaries, the day you met, anything you like.

NEVER MISS A DATE
Gentle reminders on the day and 3, 7 or 14 days before — enough time to find something special. Holiday reminders for Christmas, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Valentine's and more, aware of how your country celebrates them.

GIFT IDEAS THAT FIT
Save ideas all year, whenever inspiration strikes. Need a spark? Smart suggestions match each person's tastes, age and sizes — from cozy classics to experiences they'll never forget.

TASTES, SIZES & NOTES
Keep track of what they love, their clothing and shoe sizes, and the little notes that make a gift personal.

GIFT HISTORY
Log what you gave each year, so you never repeat a gift — and always top the last one.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays yours, synced privately with iCloud across iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Giftly — for the moments that matter.
after.whatsNew:
CONFETTI ON THE BIG DAY
When someone's birthday is today, Giftly throws confetti every time you open it.

THE SEASON ON SCREEN
Snow all Christmas week, golden sparkles at New Year, hearts on Valentine's Day, eggs at Easter, petals on Mother's Day and balloons on Children's Day.

A WARMER WELCOME
New here? Bring your people's birthdays in from Contacts on the very first screen.

GIFTLY PRO
Free Giftly remembers up to 5 people. Pro removes the limit and unlocks every widget: monthly, yearly or pay once for life, with Family Sharing. Already have more than 5? Nobody leaves: everyone you added stays.

Every birthday deserves a little party.
